parent_objective: implement no-checkpoint multi-scale multi-seed damped projection stress test
blocked_by: M1645 pre-registers stress grid and aggregate gates before any checkpoint artifact or PPO route

public_gates: M1646 must run exactly the M1645 scale/seed grid
M1646 must use damped_backtracking projection mode and actor_mean-only scope
M1646 must write aggregate stress artifacts and no checkpoint files
M1646 must keep diagnostics zero-weight and donor-plus actions excluded from loss
M1646 must route to result audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not alter the scale/seed grid after seeing results
do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements one no-checkpoint perturbation stress test over the M1645 fixed grid
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective-sanity stress test only; no checkpoint artifact, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if aggregate pass criteria fail
stop if any checkpoint artifact is written
stop if scale/seed grid differs from design
stop if diagnostics or donor-plus guardrails fail
stop after implementation for mandatory result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether stress passes or fails
pivot away from checkpoint artifact if stress fails
route to branch synthesis if another implementation would exceed cadence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1645 admits one bounded stress implementation

training_stage.stage_objective: run no-checkpoint damped projection stress test
admission_evidence: M1645 pre-registered the grid and aggregate gates
allowed_updates: stress-test module or extension and focused tests
M1646 docs status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: audit route is explicit before checkpoint artifact or PPO route

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1646 tests fixed-tensor exact-objective stress only and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: evaluates correct/wrong hidden branch exact residual across controlled perturbation seeds
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If stress fails, record the failure class and audit before any further projection repair or checkpoint artifact.
allowed_claims: bounded no-checkpoint damped projection stress result
no PPO, no promotion, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The damped projection rule remains stable across the fixed M1645 perturbation scale/seed grid without writing checkpoints or violating role guardrails.
success_criteria: training_started_count ppo_used_count promoted_count private_holdout_used_count actor_input_contract_changed_count level3_self_id_claim_count are 0
failure_criteria: scale/seed grid differs from M1645 design
aggregate residual or candidate pass thresholds fail
base interpolation is used for repair
diagnostics or donor-plus actions enter the loss target
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or level3 claims are produced
decision_rule: M1646 passes if the fixed stress grid meets aggregate no-checkpoint projection gates.
